tripwires.basis: GAAP operating expense growth minus revenue growth, points
tripwires.note: Breached in 1 of the last 2 quarters; it needs 2.

rev_cagr.method: Blend of latest TTM growth (50%), 3-year CAGR (30%) and 5-year CAGR (20%), decaying 25% a year toward 4% nominal growth

margin_end.method: AR(1) mean reversion of annual GAAP net margin (mean 50.0%, persistence 0.30) projected 3 years

share_chg.method: Annualised change in the diluted share count implied by net income over diluted EPS: 3-year (60%) and 5-year (40%) where five years exist, otherwise the 3-year rate

exit_pe.method: Half of the gap between today's GAAP P/E and the company's own median P/E (quarter ends, price over GAAP TTM EPS) closes over three years
